description: B2: 2D bounding boxes for automatic clusters, per-category and per-selection; PNG export includes boxes; unrotated and rotated pixel assertions.
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
k = rng.integers(0, 4, 8000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (4, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (8000, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: wait for ready
steps.report: { phase: a.phase, nAnchors: a.nAnchors, nKept: a.nKept }

steps.name: enable automatic clusters
steps.eval: const s = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Label by"]'); s.value = 'clusters'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: enable outline style box
steps.eval: const cb = document.querySelector('input[type=checkbox][aria-label="Show outlines"]') || Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label')).find(l => l.textContent.includes('Show outlines'))?.querySelector('input'); if (cb && !cb.checked) { cb.click(); } const s = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Outline style"]'); if (s) { s.value = 'box'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }

steps.name: boxes are rendered (non-background pixels in the deck.gl canvas)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = cv.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__boxPx = n;

steps.name: box extents are present in the renderer
steps.report: { clusterCount: a.clusterCount, outlines: a.labels.outlines, outlineStyle: a.labels.outlineStyle }

steps.name: rotate map 30 degrees and verify boxes rotate with the map
boxes still visible after rotation (pixel count not zero)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = cv.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__boxPxRot = n;

steps.name: selection box: lasso a region and verify selection box appears
steps.eval: const c = a.renderer.container; const w = c.clientWidth, h = c.clientHeight; const poly = [[w*0.3, h*0.3], [w*0.7, h*0.3], [w*0.7, h*0.7], [w*0.3, h*0.7]]; a.applyLasso(poly, 'replace')

steps.name: selection box pixel scan (box around selected region is drawn)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = cv.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__selPx = n;

steps.name: PNG export includes boxes (non-blank export)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = cv.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__exportPx = n;
